sloka: ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणैर्भिन्ना विपेतुर्भुवि भीमकायाः ।ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः ।। ६.५९.४४ ।।।।
transliteration: te vānarendrāstridaśāribāṇairbhinnā vipeturbhuvi bhīmakāyāḥ ।tatastu tadvānarasainyamugraṁ pracchādayāmāsa sa bāṇajālaiḥ ।। 6.59.44 ।।।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.
